translated_title: The Sino-Mexican Friendship: An Aged Wine That Grows More Beautiful with Time
original_title: La amistad sino-mexicana: un vino añejo que se embellece con el tiempo

meta_description: China’s Ambassador to Mexico, Chen Daojiang, marks over 50 years of ties—US$100 billion in trade, 200+ Chinese firms, and shared Global South leadership—ahead of APEC.
